scope: aggregate read-only audit; no personal meal contents exported
query: select jsonb_build_object('client_date','2026-10-27','scope','aggregate read-only audit; no personal meal contents exported','counts',(select jsonb_object_agg(metric,n) from (select 'daily_food_entries' metric,count(*) n from public.daily_food_entries union all select 'macro_source_unknown',count(*) from public.daily_food_entries where nullif(parse_meta->>'macroSource','') is null union all select 'food_library',count(*) from public.food_library union all select 'food_reference_pl',count(*) from public.food_reference_pl union all select 'food_favorites',count(*) from public.food_favorites union all select 'complete_days',count(*) from public.nutrition_day_reviews where completeness='complete' union all select 'partial_days',count(*) from public.nutrition_day_reviews where completeness='partial' union all select 'meal_captures',count(*) from public.nutrition_meal_captures) t),'library_sources',(select jsonb_object_agg(source,n) from(select coalesce(source,'unknown') source,count(*) n from public.food_library group by 1)t),'macro_sources',(select jsonb_object_agg(source,n) from(select coalesce(nullif(parse_meta->>'macroSource',''),'unknown') source,count(*) n from public.daily_food_entries group by 1)t),'numeric_mass_column',(select exists(select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='daily_food_entries' and column_name in ('amount_grams','grams','mass_g') and data_type in ('numeric','integer','double precision'))),'food_embedding_columns',(select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name in ('food_library','food_reference_pl') and udt_name='vector'),'extensions',(select jsonb_object_agg(extname,extversion) from pg_extension where extname in ('vector','pg_trgm'))) audit;
interpretation_limits: Database metadata and aggregate counts only; no meal ground truth or performance measurement.
Local source was inspected; deployed edge function parity was not verified.
A textual amount in grams does not prove a weighed portion.
A matching current library name cannot establish historical provenance.
